name: Context7
description: Up-to-date documentation for a library, resolved by name and version.
long_description: Context7 indexes library documentation and serves the current version of it. You name a library the way you would say it out loud, it resolves that to an id, and the docs it returns match the version you are actually using — which is the failure mode models have with fast-moving packages. Public documentation only; it sees nothing of your code.
